tasks.title: Create model lab-k8s-pebble
tasks.instructions:
Create a new model named `lab-k8s-pebble`:

```bash
juju add-model lab-k8s-pebble
```

Verify that `lab-k8s-pebble` is active:

```bash
juju switch
```

tasks.title: Deploy container-app
tasks.instructions:
Deploy the `ubuntu` charm with application name `container-app` into `lab-k8s-pebble`:

```bash
juju deploy ubuntu container-app --channel latest/stable -m lab-k8s-pebble
```

Verify application status:

```bash
juju status -m lab-k8s-pebble
```
hints: Syntax: `juju deploy ubuntu container-app --channel latest/stable -m lab-k8s-pebble`.
tasks.solution:

juju deploy ubuntu container-app --channel latest/stable -m lab-k8s-pebble

tasks.title: Execute remote command on unit
tasks.instructions:
Execute a remote command to touch the ready marker file `/tmp/pebble-sim.ready` on `container-app/0`:

```bash
juju exec -m lab-k8s-pebble --unit container-app/0 "touch /tmp/pebble-sim.ready"
```

Verify that the marker exists on the unit:

```bash
juju exec -m lab-k8s-pebble --unit container-app/0 "ls -l /tmp/pebble-sim.ready"
```
